title: Virat Kohli Has Not Played a Single MLC Match — and Mi New York’s Bench Might Be the Most Star-Studded in Cricket History
excerpt: The defending champions’ registered squad includes Kohli, AB de Villiers, Chris Gayle, Kane Williamson, Joe Root, and Glenn Phillips — none of whom have been in the playing XI as the season enters its third week.
body:
When Major League Cricket unveiled its 2026 rosters, one name set social media ablaze: Virat Kohli, the modern game’s most recognisable face, would suit up for the defending champion Mi New York. For the hundreds of thousands of Indian Americans who had been waiting for a reason to care about domestic cricket on US soil, the announcement felt like a coronation.

Two weeks into Season 4, Kohli has yet to step onto the field.

Match after match — four in all, from the Grand Prairie opener against Washington Freedom on June 20 through the most recent clash with Los Angeles Knight Riders on June 28 — Kohli’s name has appeared in one unchanging column: the bench. And he is not alone. AB de Villiers, Chris Gayle, Kane Williamson, Joe Root, and Glenn Phillips have all been listed alongside him, watching from the sidelines while the playing XI does the heavy lifting.

## An Embarrassment of Riches — Or a Management Headache?

Mi New York, owned by Reliance Industries’ Indiawin Sports and captained by Nicholas Pooran under coach Mark Boucher, are the two-time MLC champions (2023, 2025). Their registered squad reads like a greatest-hits compilation of world cricket: Quinton de Kock and Pooran behind the stumps, Kieron Pollard providing middle-order muscle, Trent Boult opening the bowling with the new ball, and South Africa’s Corbin Bosch — who produced a match-winning 4/29 against Texas Super Kings — adding pace depth.

The question NRI fans across the tristate area and the Bay Area keep asking: if the squad is this deep, why can’t any of the big names get a game?



> **"Mi New York, owned by Reliance Industries’ Indiawin Sports and captained by Nicholas Pooran under coach Mark Boucher, are the two-time MLC champions (2023, 2025)."**


Part of the answer may lie in workload management. Kohli sustained a minor ankle injury during an IPL 2026 match against Mumbai Indians on April 12, when he twisted it while batting a brisk 50 off 38 balls at Wankhede Stadium. Though described as a niggle at the time, the injury was significant enough that he did not take the field for the second innings. With Kohli also named in India’s ODI squad for the England tour beginning July 14 — under Shubman Gill’s captaincy — the BCCI and Mi New York appear to be erring on the side of caution, treating MLC as a conditioning window rather than a competitive proving ground.

The overseas legends carry different constraints. MLC franchises register expansive squads, but the league’s overseas-player caps and match-day restrictions mean only a handful can feature in any given XI. Veterans like Gayle (46) and de Villiers (42) are marquee names that sell tickets and jerseys; their on-field contributions, if they materialise, may be timed for the playoffs, when Oakland Coliseum hosts the knockouts from July 15 to 18.


![Grand Prairie — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/f1/Grand_Prairie_May_2019_27_%28Market_Square_water_tower%29.jpg/3840px-Grand_Prairie_May_2019_27_%28Market_Square_water_tower%29.jpg)


## How the Season Stands

Without Kohli, Mi New York sit fifth in the six-team table with four points from four matches — two wins, two losses. Pollard’s thunderous unbeaten century (100 off 56 balls) against Washington Freedom on June 20 could not prevent a 30-run defeat, as the Freedom’s Mitchell Owen blasted a staggering 155 off 68. The team bounced back the following night, hammering Texas Super Kings by eight wickets behind Pooran’s fluent 68 not out. A shaky 127/9 against the Super Kings on June 27 brought a second loss before a convincing 41-run victory over LA Knight Riders on June 28 levelled the ledger.

The standings are extraordinarily tight. San Francisco Unicorns, Seattle Orcas, Texas Super Kings, and Washington Freedom are all locked on six points, with net run rate the only separator. Mi New York trail them by two points but have games in hand — and a daunting run of fixtures that could define their season.

## Tonight in Redmond: A Chance for Kohli?

Mi New York face Seattle Orcas tonight (July 2) at Marymoor Cricket Community Park Stadium in Redmond, Washington — just 20 minutes from Microsoft’s campus and one of the Pacific Northwest’s fastest-growing cricket venues. The match, starting at 6:30 PM Pacific, carries added intrigue: could this be the night Kohli finally walks out to bat on American soil?

For NRI fans in the Seattle-Bellevue tech corridor, many of whom relocated from Hyderabad, Bengaluru, and Mumbai, the prospect of watching Kohli in their suburban backyard feels surreal. Weekend MLC matches at Bay Area and Pacific Northwest venues have drawn enthusiastic desi crowds, complete with dhol players, Indian food trucks, and tricolour flags. Even without Kohli batting, the atmosphere has underscored what MLC’s organisers have long believed: the Indian diaspora is American cricket’s commercial engine.

## The Bigger Picture

MLC Season 4, running from June 18 to July 18, represents the league’s most ambitious footprint yet — Grand Prairie, Oakland, Marine Park in New York, and now Redmond. The presence of a Kohli or a Williamson in the squad, even if they remain on the bench, lends credibility that no marketing budget can buy.

But credibility and patience are different currencies. If Kohli departs for England without having faced a single delivery in MLC, it will be a missed opportunity — not just for him, but for a league that needs its biggest names on the pitch, not in the dugout, to convince American sports fans that cricket belongs here.
